title: Dynamic Activation Balancer: calibration pipeline, validation harness, and microkernel routing for INT8 activation-aware quant
creator: Samir Khatri
description:
Problem: Model families with large activation variance (Mixture-of-Experts and some dense transformers) show >2% relative quality regression when naively converted to INT8 with weight-only calibration. SmoothQuant-style activation-aware rescaling reduces bias but requires a coordinated pipeline that produces per-layer scale profiles, validates accuracy across prompt sets, and generates runtime artifacts (microkernel routing table + fallback rules).

Goal: Deliver an end-to-end feature that: (1) runs a reproducible calibration job producing per-tensor activation rescale profiles; (2) validates quantized model quality via an automated accuracy harness against golden prompt suites; (3) builds a lightweight runtime manifest that routes operators to microkernels optimized for activation-rescaled INT8 or to FP16/FP32 fallbacks under SLO/cost constraints; (4) exposes a canary rollout and rollback path in the console.

Scope: Calibration orchestration (offline), profile serialization format, validation harness expansion (golden prompts + drift detection), runtime kernel selection and routing table, CI gating and PR checklist, observability metrics for quality and perf, and rollout plan for Dedicated and Hosted tiers.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration job (k8s/airflow) produces per-layer rescale .json and coverage report for a given model and calibration dataset
Validation harness runs automatically on PRs and produces quality delta report (top-1/token-level) against baseline FP16 for configured prompt suites
Runtime artifact format (rescale manifest + kernel routing table) defined and documented; runtime applies per-shard routing without model-rewrite latency >2ms
Fallback policy implemented: if tail-latency or quality delta > configured threshold, route to FP16 kernel automatically
E2E benchmark: sample Llama-2-70B run shows <1.5% quality loss and <10% token cost improvement vs FP16 on p4d-equivalent in Dedicated
Documentation and console toggles for canary rollout available; runbook for rollback verified by SRE
notes: 2025-01-12: Kickoff meeting — agreed to keep calibration dataset small and representative (10k prompts plus stratified long-tail set). Action: PM to provide customer examples and golden prompts (PM: Jordan Lee).

2025-01-15: Trade-off: per-channel vs per-tensor rescale — perf team favors per-tensor for simpler microkernel vectorization; accuracy team requests hybrid option. Decided to support both but default to per-channel for models with >32 heads per layer.

2025-01-22: Prototype calibrator produced initial .rescale.json for llama-2-13b. Observed 2.8% end-task BLEU drop on translation test with weight-only quant. Activation-aware rescale reduced to 0.9% — promising.

2025-01-29: Runtime discussion: two approaches considered — (A) model rewrite inserting scale ops (slower, more intrusive), (B) kernel-level rescale during GEMM (preferred). Opted for kernel-level rescale with a routing table to pick kernels compiled for (rescaled-INT8) or baseline kernels.
2025-02-04: CI gating: added accuracy-check job that runs on the PR with a sampled golden prompt set. Thresholds: fail PR if median relative quality drop >1.5% or any critical prompt fails.

2025-02-08: Engineering spike: implemented prototype microkernel that composes activation-rescale and quantized matmul in a single codepath. Perf rough numbers: 12-14% faster than fallback FP16 for 2048 seq on A100 with batch=1.
2025-02-10: Design review with DevEx: need explanatory console UI showing per-model rescale profile and per-route cost/latency delta. UX ticket created (DES-211).

qa_plan: Unit tests for calibration serialize/deserialize and edge-case tensors (zero variance, outliers)
Integration tests that run calibrator -> quantize -> runtime in CI with smoke workload
Automated accuracy regression check against golden prompt suite (10k short prompts + 1k long prompts)
Performance smoke on a small Dedicated pool (p4d-sim) measuring tail-latency and token throughput
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal canary (engineering + benchmark team) — enable rescaled-INT8 for 2 small models
Phase 1: limited customer beta on Dedicated (opt-in) with monitoring enabled and automatic rollback on quality regressions
Phase 2: gradual rollout to hosted tier with percent traffic gates and monitoring dashboards
Rollback: immediate revert to FP16 kernel routing via console toggle + automated remediation if cumulative quality delta > configured threshold for 1 hour
open_questions: Should the calibrator shipped format include per-dtype (INT8/FP8) suggestions or only rescale multipliers?
What is the canonical fidelity metric for multi-task models (use composite of BLEU/ROUGE/Token-acc?), proposed: task-weighted composite agreed by PM & Research
How to expose cost-vs-quality tradeoffs in the console without overwhelming users? UX to provide mockups
